<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Lifestyle Medicine Program — Cardiovascular Specialists of New England</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,wght@0,300;0,600;0,900;1,300;1,600&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
:root{
  --navy:#1E3A8A;
  --red:#D0263C;
  --sky:#5AABDA;
  --cream:#F5F4F0;
  --charcoal:#1A1A1A;
  --warm:#F9F6F0;
  --mist:#EAF0F7;
  --night:#0C1829;
  --border:rgba(30,58,138,0.12);
  --ff:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;
  --fb:'DM Sans',sans-serif;
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
body{font-family:var(--fb);background:var(--cream);color:var(--charcoal);overflow-x:hidden;}

/* PROGRESS */
#prog{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;height:3px;width:0%;background:var(–red);z-index:300;transition:width .08s linear;}

/* NAV */
nav{
position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:200;
display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
padding:16px 52px;
background:rgba(245,244,240,0.94);
backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
border-bottom:1px solid var(–border);
transition:all .3s;
}
nav.scrolled{padding:12px 52px;box-shadow:0 4px 30px rgba(30,58,138,.08);}
.nav-logo img{height:46px;width:auto;display:block;}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:28px;list-style:none;}
.nav-links a{font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;color:var(–navy);opacity:.6;transition:opacity .2s;}
.nav-links a:hover{opacity:1;}
.nav-btn{padding:10px 22px;background:var(–red);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:30px;font-family:var(–fb);font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:all .25s;}
.nav-btn:hover{background:#b01e30;transform:translateY(-1px);}

/* SCROLL DOTS */
#dots{position:fixed;right:22px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:100;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;}
.dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(30,58,138,.2);border:1.5px solid rgba(30,58,138,.3);cursor:pointer;transition:all .3s;}
.dot.active{background:var(–red);border-color:var(–red);transform:scale(1.5);}
.dot.on-dark{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);}
.dot.on-dark.active{background:var(–sky);border-color:var(–sky);}

/* REVEAL */
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px);transition:opacity .75s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1),transform .75s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1);}
.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}
.d1{transition-delay:.1s;}.d2{transition-delay:.22s;}.d3{transition-delay:.35s;}.d4{transition-delay:.48s;}.d5{transition-delay:.62s;}

/* COMMON */
.section-tag{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(–red);margin-bottom:18px;}
.section-tag::before{content:’’;width:22px;height:1px;background:var(–red);}
.section-tag.light{color:var(–sky);}
.section-tag.light::before{background:var(–sky);}
.section-h2{font-family:var(–ff);font-size:clamp(2rem,3.2vw,3.4rem);font-weight:600;line-height:1.1;color:var(–navy);margin-bottom:52px;max-width:660px;}
.section-h2 em{color:var(–red);font-style:italic;font-weight:300;}
.section-h2.light{color:#fff;}
.section-h2.light em{color:var(–sky);}

/* ─── HERO ─── */
#s0{min-height:100vh;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;align-items:center;background:var(–warm);}
.hero-l{padding:130px 60px 80px 72px;}
.hero-eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(–red);margin-bottom:22px;}
.hero-eyebrow::before{content:’’;width:22px;height:1px;background:var(–red);}
.hero-h1{font-family:var(–ff);font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(2.8rem,4.5vw,5rem);line-height:1.06;color:var(–navy);margin-bottom:26px;}
.hero-h1 em{color:var(–red);font-style:italic;font-weight:300;}
.hero-sub{font-size:1rem;line-height:1.82;color:#4A5568;font-weight:300;max-width:440px;margin-bottom:42px;}
.hero-actions{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:52px;}
.btn-solid{padding:14px 32px;background:var(–navy);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:32px;font-family:var(–fb);font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:all .25s;}
.btn-solid:hover{background:var(–red);transform:translateY(-2px);}
.btn-ghost{padding:14px 32px;background:transparent;color:var(–navy);border:1.5px solid var(–navy);border-radius:32px;font-family:var(–fb);font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:all .25s;}
.btn-ghost:hover{background:var(–navy);color:#fff;transform:translateY(-2px);}
.hero-stats{display:flex;gap:36px;padding-top:38px;border-top:1px solid var(–border);}
.stat-n{font-family:var(–ff);font-size:2.2rem;font-weight:600;color:var(–navy);}
.stat-l{font-size:.7rem;color:#718096;letter-spacing:.05em;margin-top:2px;}
.hero-r{position:relative;height:100vh;}
.hero-img-frame{position:absolute;inset:48px 0 48px 24px;border-radius:28px 0 0 28px;overflow:hidden;}
.hero-img-frame img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
.hero-badge{position:absolute;bottom:92px;left:-26px;background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:18px 22px;box-shadow:0 16px 50px rgba(30,58,138,.15);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;min-width:210px;}
.badge-icon{font-size:1.5rem;}
.badge-text{font-size:.76rem;line-height:1.55;color:var(–charcoal);}
.badge-text strong{display:block;font-size:.83rem;color:var(–navy);}

/* MARQUEE */
.marquee-bar{background:var(–navy);padding:15px 0;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;}
.marquee-inner{display:inline-block;animation:marquee 32s linear infinite;font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);}
.marquee-inner span{margin:0 28px;}
.mdot{color:var(–sky);}
@keyframes marquee{from{transform:translateX(0);}to{transform:translateX(-50%);}}

/* ─── MISSION ─── */
#s1{background:var(–warm);padding:110px 72px;}
.mission-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr;gap:64px;align-items:start;}
.mission-statement{background:var(–navy);border-radius:24px;padding:44px;color:#fff;}
.ms-label{font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(–sky);margin-bottom:16px;}
.ms-text{font-family:var(–ff);font-size:1.18rem;font-weight:300;line-height:1.8;font-style:italic;color:rgba(255,255,255,.9);}
.ms-rule{width:36px;height:2px;background:var(–red);margin:22px 0;}
.ms-tagline{font-size:.8rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);letter-spacing:.05em;line-height:1.6;}
.philosophy-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;}
.philo-item{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;padding:20px;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid var(–border);background:#fff;transition:all .3s;}
.philo-item:hover{border-color:var(–navy);box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(30,58,138,.08);transform:translateX(6px);}
.philo-num{font-family:var(–ff);font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:600;color:var(–red);min-width:26px;line-height:1;}
.philo-text{font-size:.86rem;line-height:1.68;color:#4A5568;}

/* ─── PILLARS ─── */
#s2{background:var(–night);padding:110px 72px;color:#fff;}
.pillars-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:2px;}
.pillars-grid-3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:2px;margin-top:2px;}
.pillar{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);padding:36px 28px;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);transition:background .3s;cursor:default;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.pillar::after{content:’’;position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:var(–red);transform:scaleX(0);transition:transform .35s;transform-origin:left;}
.pillar:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);}
.pillar:hover::after{transform:scaleX(1);}
.pillars-grid .pillar:last-child,.pillars-grid-3 .pillar:last-child{border-right:none;}
.pillar-num{font-family:var(–ff);font-size:.9rem;color:var(–sky);opacity:.45;margin-bottom:14px;font-weight:300;}
.pillar-icon{font-size:1.7rem;margin-bottom:12px;}
.pillar-title{font-family:var(–ff);font-size:1.15rem;color:#fff;margin-bottom:10px;font-weight:600;}
.pillar-desc{font-size:.78rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.48);line-height:1.68;}

/* ─── TRACKS ─── */
#s3{background:var(–warm);padding:110px 72px;}
.tracks-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.3fr;gap:64px;align-items:start;}
.track-cards{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;}
.track-card{border-radius:16px;padding:20px 22px;border:1.5px solid var(–border);background:#fff;cursor:pointer;transition:all .3s;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;}
.track-card:hover,.track-card.active{border-color:var(–navy);background:var(–navy);color:#fff;}
.track-card:hover .tc-name,.track-card.active .tc-name{color:#fff;}
.track-card:hover .tc-sub,.track-card.active .tc-sub{color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);}
.track-card:hover .tc-num,.track-card.active .tc-num{color:var(–sky);}
.tc-num{font-family:var(–ff);font-size:1.35rem;font-weight:600;color:var(–red);min-width:30px;}
.tc-name{font-size:.9rem;font-weight:500;color:var(–navy);}
.tc-sub{font-size:.72rem;color:#718096;margin-top:2px;}
.tc-arrow{margin-left:auto;font-size:.9rem;opacity:.35;}
.track-detail{background:var(–navy);border-radius:24px;padding:42px;color:#fff;position:sticky;top:96px;}
.td-label{font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(–sky);margin-bottom:14px;}
.td-title{font-family:var(–ff);font-size:1.75rem;font-weight:600;color:#fff;margin-bottom:18px;line-height:1.2;}
.td-desc{font-size:.86rem;line-height:1.82;color:rgba(255,255,255,.63);margin-bottom:26px;}
.td-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;}
.td-tag{padding:6px 14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:20px;font-size:.7rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.72);letter-spacing:.04em;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);}

/* ─── CURRICULUM ─── */
#s4{background:var(–cream);padding:110px 72px;}
.week-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px;}
.week-card{background:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:26px;border:1px solid var(–border);transition:all .35s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1);cursor:default;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.week-card::after{content:’’;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(–navy),var(–sky));transform:scaleX(0);transition:transform .35s;transform-origin:left;}
.week-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 18px 48px rgba(30,58,138,.1);}
.week-card:hover::after{transform:scaleX(1);}
.wk-badge{display:inline-block;padding:4px 11px;border-radius:20px;background:var(–mist);color:var(–navy);font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:12px;font-weight:500;}
.wk-title{font-family:var(–ff);font-size:1rem;font-weight:600;color:var(–navy);margin-bottom:8px;line-height:1.35;}
.wk-focus{font-size:.72rem;color:var(–red);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:9px;font-weight:500;}
.wk-desc{font-size:.8rem;color:#718096;line-height:1.68;}
.week-card.capstone{border-color:var(–navy);background:var(–mist);}
.week-card.capstone .wk-badge{background:var(–navy);color:#fff;}
.week-card.capstone .wk-title{color:var(–navy);}

/* ─── SMA FORMAT ─── */
#s5{background:var(–night);padding:110px 72px;color:#fff;}
.sma-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:64px;align-items:center;}
.sma-visual{text-align:center;}
.sma-circle{width:300px;height:300px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid rgba(90,171,218,.2);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;margin:0 auto 28px;}
.sma-circle::before{content:’’;position:absolute;width:220px;height:220px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(90,171,218,.1);}
.sma-center{z-index:2;text-align:center;}
.sma-big{font-family:var(–ff);font-size:3.8rem;font-weight:900;color:var(–sky);line-height:1;}
.sma-lbl{font-size:.7rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.38);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:6px;}
.orbit-item{position:absolute;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 14px;font-size:.68rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);white-space:nowrap;}
.o1{top:-12px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);}
.o2{right:-56px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);}
.o3{bottom:-12px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);}
.o4{left:-60px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);}
.sma-mini-stats{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;}
.mini-stat{text-align:center;padding:14px 18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:14px;}
.mini-stat-n{font-family:var(–ff);font-size:1.6rem;color:var(–sky);font-weight:600;}
.mini-stat-l{font-size:.66rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.38);letter-spacing:.07em;margin-top:3px;}
.sma-cards{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px;}
.sma-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:18px;padding:22px;}
.smc-label{font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(–sky);margin-bottom:10px;}
.smc-items{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;}
.smc-items li{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:9px;font-size:.83rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.62);line-height:1.55;}
.smc-items li::before{content:‘→’;color:var(–sky);flex-shrink:0;font-size:.75rem;margin-top:2px;}

/* ─── OUTCOMES ─── */
#s6{background:var(–warm);padding:110px 72px;}
.outcomes-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px;margin-top:52px;}
.outcome-card{border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .3s;}
.outcome-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);}
.oc-header{padding:26px 26px 18px;background:var(–navy);color:#fff;}
.oc-icon{font-size:1.4rem;margin-bottom:8px;}
.oc-title{font-family:var(–ff);font-size:1.1rem;color:#fff;font-weight:600;}
.oc-body{background:#fff;padding:22px 26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;}
.oc-metric{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:6px;font-family:var(–ff);font-size:1.45rem;font-weight:600;color:var(–navy);margin-bottom:14px;}
.oc-metric span{font-size:.7rem;color:#718096;font-family:var(–fb);letter-spacing:.04em;}
.oc-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;font-size:.81rem;color:#4A5568;line-height:1.55;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(30,58,138,.06);}
.oc-item:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.oc-dot{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(–red);flex-shrink:0;}

/* ─── REGION ─── */
#s7{background:var(–mist);padding:110px 72px;}
.region-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:64px;align-items:start;}
.region-panel{background:var(–navy);border-radius:26px;padding:44px;color:#fff;}
.region-t{font-family:var(–ff);font-size:1.4rem;color:#fff;margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:600;}
.region-s{font-size:.78rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);margin-bottom:28px;}
.region-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px;}
.region-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:13px 16px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border-radius:12px;font-size:.83rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.78);}
.ri-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;}
.ri-dot.nh{background:var(–sky);}
.ri-dot.ma{background:var(–red);}
.ri-dot.tele{background:#4A7C59;}
.region-right{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;}
.team-stat{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:22px;background:#fff;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid var(–border);transition:all .3s;}
.team-stat:hover{border-color:var(–navy);box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(30,58,138,.08);}
.ts-num{font-family:var(–ff);font-size:2.3rem;font-weight:900;color:var(–navy);min-width:65px;}
.ts-label{font-size:.9rem;font-weight:500;color:var(–charcoal);}
.ts-sub{font-size:.72rem;color:#718096;margin-top:3px;}
.tele-badge{background:var(–navy);border-radius:18px;padding:22px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;}
.tb-icon{font-size:1.6rem;}
.tb-title{font-size:.9rem;font-weight:500;color:#fff;margin-bottom:4px;}
.tb-sub{font-size:.72rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);}

/* ─── CTA ─── */
#s8{background:var(–navy);padding:130px 72px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:100vh;justify-content:center;}
#s8::before{content:’’;position:absolute;width:620px;height:620px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(90,171,218,.1);top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);}
#s8::after{content:’’;position:absolute;width:360px;height:360px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(208,38,60,.15);top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);}
.cta-logo{margin-bottom:40px;position:relative;z-index:2;}
.cta-logo img{height:50px;filter:brightness(0) invert(1);}
.cta-eyebrow{font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(–sky);margin-bottom:18px;position:relative;z-index:2;}
.cta-h2{font-family:var(–ff);font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(2.4rem,4vw,4.5rem);line-height:1.06;color:#fff;margin-bottom:18px;position:relative;z-index:2;}
.cta-h2 em{color:var(–sky);font-style:italic;font-weight:300;}
.cta-sub{font-size:.98rem;line-height:1.82;color:rgba(255,255,255,.52);max-width:500px;margin:0 auto 46px;position:relative;z-index:2;}
.cta-btns{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;position:relative;z-index:2;margin-bottom:56px;}
.btn-red-lg{padding:15px 38px;background:var(–red);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:36px;font-family:var(–fb);font-size:.82rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:all .25s;}
.btn-red-lg:hover{background:#b01e30;transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(208,38,60,.35);}
.btn-outline-lg{padding:15px 38px;background:transparent;color:rgba(255,255,255,.78);border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);border-radius:36px;font-family:var(–fb);font-size:.82rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:all .25s;}
.btn-outline-lg:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);color:#fff;transform:translateY(-2px);}
.footer-nav{position:relative;z-index:2;display:flex;gap:28px;list-style:none;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.28);}
.footer-nav a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;transition:color .2s;}
.footer-nav a:hover{color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);}

/* RESPONSIVE */
@media(max-width:980px){
#s0{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
.hero-r{display:none;}
.hero-l{padding:110px 32px 60px;}
nav{padding:14px 24px;}
.nav-links{display:none;}
#s1,#s2,#s3,#s4,#s5,#s6,#s7,#s8{padding:80px 32px;}
.mission-grid,.tracks-layout,.sma-layout,.region-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:32px;}
.outcomes-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
.week-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
.pillars-grid,.pillars-grid-3{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
.pillar{border-right:none;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);}
.hero-stats{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px;}
}
@media(max-width:580px){
.week-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
.pillars-grid,.pillars-grid-3{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
.sma-mini-stats{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;}
}
</style>

</head>
<body>

<div id="prog"></div>

<nav id="navbar">
  <div class="nav-logo"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Cardiovascular Specialists of New England"></div>
  <ul class="nav-links">
    <li><a href="#s1">Mission</a></li>
    <li><a href="#s2">Pillars</a></li>
    <li><a href="#s3">Programs</a></li>
    <li><a href="#s4">Curriculum</a></li>
    <li><a href="#s5">SMA Format</a></li>
    <li><a href="#s6">Outcomes</a></li>
    <li><a href="#s7">Our Region</a></li>

<!-- MISSION -->

<section id="s1">
  <div class="section-tag reveal">How We Think About Your Care</div>
  <h2 class="section-h2 reveal d1">Real change starts with <em>how you live,</em><br>not just what you take</h2>
  <div class="mission-grid">
    <div class="mission-statement reveal d1">
      <div class="ms-label">Our Commitment to You</div>
      <div class="ms-text">"We believe that heart disease, diabetes, high blood pressure, and obesity can be prevented — and often reversed — through the right lifestyle changes, supported by a dedicated clinical team that walks alongside you every step of the way."</div>
      <div class="ms-rule"></div>
      <div class="ms-tagline">Cardiovascular Specialists of New England — your dedicated heart health team</div>
    </div>
    <div class="philosophy-list reveal d2">
      <div class="philo-item">
        <div class="philo-num">01</div>
        <div class="philo-text">Heart disease, diabetes, high blood pressure, and obesity can be treated — and often reversed — by changing the way we live, not just the medications we take.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="philo-item">
        <div class="philo-num">02</div>
        <div class="philo-text">Lifestyle change is our first treatment, not an afterthought. Your medications support the changes you make — not the other way around.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="philo-item">
        <div class="philo-num">03</div>
        <div class="philo-text">Lasting change takes time, support, and a team around you. We're with you for the long haul — not just one appointment.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="philo-item">
        <div class="philo-num">04</div>
        <div class="philo-text">We never judge. Setbacks happen to everyone — we help you get back on track without shame or stigma.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="philo-item">
        <div class="philo-num">05</div>
        <div class="philo-text">Progress isn't about being perfect. It's about consistent effort, the support of your group, and celebrating every step forward.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- PILLARS -->

<section id="s2">
  <div class="section-tag light reveal">ACLM-Aligned Core Pillars</div>
  <h2 class="section-h2 light reveal d1">Seven areas of your life that <em>shape your heart health</em></h2>
  <div class="pillars-grid">
    <div class="pillar reveal d1">
      <div class="pillar-num">01</div>
      <div class="pillar-icon">🥗</div>
      <div class="pillar-title">Whole-Food Nutrition</div>
      <div class="pillar-desc">Learn to eat in a way that protects your heart — delicious, realistic, and backed by decades of research.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="pillar reveal d2">
      <div class="pillar-num">02</div>
      <div class="pillar-icon">🏃</div>
      <div class="pillar-title">Physical Activity</div>
      <div class="pillar-desc">Find movement that fits your life and your health. We'll build a safe, personalized plan together — no gym required.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="pillar reveal d3">
      <div class="pillar-num">03</div>
      <div class="pillar-icon">⚖️</div>
      <div class="pillar-title">Weight Management</div>
      <div class="pillar-desc">Sustainable weight management — with compassionate support, the latest medications when appropriate, and no quick-fix promises.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="pillar reveal d4">
      <div class="pillar-num">04</div>
      <div class="pillar-icon">🌙</div>
      <div class="pillar-title">Sleep Health</div>
      <div class="pillar-desc">Poor sleep silently harms your heart. We help you understand and improve your sleep — from habits to screening for sleep apnea.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="pillars-grid-3">
    <div class="pillar reveal d1">
      <div class="pillar-num">05</div>
      <div class="pillar-icon">🧠</div>
      <div class="pillar-title">Stress Resilience</div>
      <div class="pillar-desc">Chronic stress raises blood pressure and damages arteries. We give you practical tools to manage stress in real life.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="pillar reveal d2">
      <div class="pillar-num">06</div>
      <div class="pillar-icon">🚭</div>
      <div class="pillar-title">Substance Risk Reduction</div>
      <div class="pillar-desc">We help you reduce habits that harm your heart — at your pace, without judgment, with real support to make it stick.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="pillar reveal d3">
      <div class="pillar-num">07</div>
      <div class="pillar-icon">🤝</div>
      <div class="pillar-title">Social Connection &amp; Purpose</div>
      <div class="pillar-desc">Loneliness is hard on the heart. Our group model connects you with others on the same journey — and that connection heals.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- TRACKS -->

  <div class="section-tag reveal">Find the Right Program for You</div>
  <h2 class="section-h2 reveal d1">One program, tailored to <em>your specific health needs</em></h2>
  <div class="tracks-layout">
    <div class="track-cards reveal d1">
      <div class="track-card active" onclick="selectTrack(this,0)">

      </div>

      </div>

        <div class="tc-arrow">→</div>

    <div class="track-detail reveal d2" id="track-detail">
      <div class="td-label">Track 01 — Primary Prevention</div>
      <div class="td-title">Cardiometabolic Prevention</div>

      <div class="td-tags">
        <span class="td-tag">AHA Primary Prevention</span>

        <span class="td-tag">≥150 min/wk Activity</span>

        <span class="td-tag">Psychosocial Risk</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- CURRICULUM -->

<section id="s4">
  <div class="section-tag reveal">What Happens Each Week</div>
  <h2 class="section-h2 reveal d1">A clear plan, week by week — <em>built around your real life</em></h2>
  <p class="reveal d2" style="font-size:.94rem;line-height:1.82;color:#4A5568;font-weight:300;max-width:700px;margin-bottom:52px;">Each week, you meet with our cardiologist, dietitian, health coach, and other specialists in a supportive small group. Sessions are 90 minutes, mix education with real skills, and are always led by a physician. In-person for the first weeks, with options for telehealth as you progress.</p>
  <div class="week-grid">
    <div class="week-card reveal d1">
      <div class="wk-badge">Week 1</div>
      <div class="wk-title">Understanding Your Heart Risk</div>
      <div class="wk-focus">Know your numbers, set your goals</div>
      <div class="wk-desc">We review your personal health numbers together — blood pressure, cholesterol, blood sugar, weight — and build your individual goal list. You'll understand your risk and leave with a clear first target.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="week-card reveal d2">
      <div class="wk-badge">Week 2</div>
      <div class="wk-title">Eating for a Healthier Heart</div>
      <div class="wk-focus">Food as medicine — practical and delicious</div>
      <div class="wk-desc">Learn the eating patterns proven to lower cholesterol, blood pressure, and inflammation — without giving up everything you love. Includes a hands-on plate-building exercise and grocery swaps.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="week-card reveal d3">
      <div class="wk-badge">Week 3</div>
      <div class="wk-title">Weight &amp; Your Heart</div>
      <div class="wk-focus">Why weight matters — and what actually works</div>
      <div class="wk-desc">Understand how weight affects your heart, and set realistic, meaningful goals. We discuss all options — including newer medications — and review your personal plan with your cardiologist.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="week-card reveal d1">
      <div class="wk-badge">Week 4</div>
      <div class="wk-title">Moving for Your Heart</div>
      <div class="wk-focus">Safe, personalized activity for every ability</div>
      <div class="wk-desc">Exercise is one of the most powerful heart medicines available. We'll build a safe, personalized activity plan suited to your condition — whether you're recovering from a procedure or just getting started.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="week-card reveal d2">
      <div class="wk-badge">Week 5</div>
      <div class="wk-title">Hypertension: Lifestyle + Pharmacology</div>
      <div class="wk-focus">Lower your blood pressure naturally</div>
      <div class="wk-desc">Discover the lifestyle changes that can meaningfully lower your blood pressure — and potentially reduce your medications. You'll learn how to track BP at home and what your numbers really mean.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="week-card reveal d3">
      <div class="wk-badge">Week 6</div>
      <div class="wk-title">Understanding Your Cholesterol</div>
      <div class="wk-focus">What the numbers mean — and how to improve them</div>
      <div class="wk-desc">Go beyond "bad cholesterol" — understand all the numbers that matter for your heart, how food and activity affect them, and how your lifestyle choices work alongside your medications.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="week-card reveal d1">
      <div class="wk-badge">Week 7</div>
      <div class="wk-title">Blood Sugar &amp; Your Heart</div>
      <div class="wk-focus">Managing diabetes to protect your heart</div>
      <div class="wk-desc">High blood sugar silently damages blood vessels. We'll show you how eating patterns, timing, and activity affect your levels — and how the right medications can protect both your blood sugar and your heart.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="week-card reveal d2">
      <div class="wk-badge">Week 8</div>
      <div class="wk-title">Heart Failure &amp; Staying Active</div>
      <div class="wk-focus">Build strength and manage symptoms</div>
      <div class="wk-desc">For patients with heart failure, this session focuses on managing fluid, staying active safely, losing weight, and using newer medications that protect heart function. You'll leave with a practical daily plan.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="week-card reveal d3">
      <div class="wk-badge">Week 9</div>
      <div class="wk-title">Atrial Fibrillation &amp; Lifestyle</div>
      <div class="wk-focus">Reduce episodes and protect your rhythm</div>
      <div class="wk-desc">Weight, alcohol, sleep apnea, and stress all affect atrial fibrillation. We'll show you the lifestyle changes with the strongest evidence for reducing AF episodes and protecting your heart rhythm.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="week-card reveal d1">
      <div class="wk-badge">Week 10</div>
      <div class="wk-title">Sleep &amp; Your Heart</div>
      <div class="wk-focus">The heart medicine hiding in your bedroom</div>
      <div class="wk-desc">Poor sleep raises blood pressure, triggers arrhythmias, and worsens heart failure. We'll screen for sleep apnea, discuss practical sleep improvements, and send you home with a personalized sleep plan.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="week-card reveal d2">
      <div class="wk-badge">Week 11</div>
      <div class="wk-title">Managing Stress for a Healthier Heart</div>
      <div class="wk-focus">Calm the nervous system, protect your arteries</div>
      <div class="wk-desc">Chronic stress is as damaging as high cholesterol. We'll explore the connection between your nervous system and your heart, and practice techniques — breathwork, mindfulness, recovery — that make a real difference.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="week-card capstone reveal d3">
      <div class="wk-badge">Week 12</div>
      <div class="wk-title">Your Plan for the Long Term</div>
      <div class="wk-focus">Bringing it all together</div>
      <div class="wk-desc">We review your progress, celebrate your wins, and build your personalized heart health plan to take home. Your medications are reassessed, and you transition to monthly check-ins to keep you on track long term.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

  <div class="cta-logo reveal"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="CSNE"></div>
  <div class="cta-eyebrow reveal d1">Now Enrolling — Talk to Your Cardiologist</div>
  <h2 class="cta-h2 reveal d2">Ready to take<br><em>the first step?</em></h2>
  <p class="cta-sub reveal d3">Ask your cardiologist about enrolling today. Our team will walk you through the program, answer your questions, and find a group that fits your schedule.</p>
  <div class="cta-btns reveal d4">
    <button class="btn-red-lg">Ask About Enrollment</button>
    <button class="btn-outline-lg">Contact Our Team</button>
  </div>
  <ul class="footer-nav reveal d5">
    <li><a href="#">Privacy</a></li>
    <li><a href="#">HIPAA Notice</a></li>
    <li><a href="#">Our Physicians</a></li>
    <li><a href="#">Locations</a></li>
    <li><a href="#">Patient Portal</a></li>
    <li><a href="#">FAQs</a></li>
    <li><a href="#">Contact</a></li>
  </ul>
</section>

<script>
const sections=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('section'));
const dots=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.dot'));
const navbar=document.getElementById('navbar');
const prog=document.getElementById('prog');

window.addEventListener('scroll',()=>{
  const st=window.scrollY;
  const dh=document.body.scrollHeight-window.innerHeight;
  prog.style.width=(st/dh*100)+'%';
  navbar.classList.toggle('scrolled',st>40);
  let active=0;
  sections.forEach((s,i)=>{if(s.getBoundingClientRect().top<=window.innerHeight*0.45)active=i;});
  dots.forEach((d,i)=>d.classList.toggle('active',i===active));
});

function gotoSection(i){sections[i]?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});}

const trackData=[
  {label:'Track 01 — Primary Prevention',title:'Cardiometabolic Prevention',desc:'For patients with elevated but modifiable cardiovascular risk — elevated CAC score, metabolic syndrome, or significant family history — who have not yet had a cardiac event. Lifestyle intervention is most powerful before disease is established.',tags:['AHA Primary Prevention','DASH / Mediterranean','&#x2265;150 min/wk Activity','BP &amp; Lipid Targets','ASCVD Risk Score','Psychosocial Risk']},
  {label:'Track 02 — Secondary Prevention',title:'Established ASCVD &amp; Post-Event',desc:'For patients after MI, PCI, CABG, PAD, or with HFpEF and AF risk. Structured lifestyle intervention reduces recurrence, supports medication optimization, and restores functional capacity.',tags:['Post-PCI / CABG','HFpEF Management','AF Risk Reduction','Cardiac Rehab Integration','LDL/ApoB Targets','Medication De-escalation']},
  {label:'Track 03 — Weight &amp; Metabolic',title:'Overweight &amp; Obesity',desc:'Adiposity-driven cardiovascular risk is addressable and reversible. This track integrates GLP-1/GIP pharmacotherapy with behavioral and nutritional strategies for durable weight loss and visceral fat reduction.',tags:['GLP-1/GIP Integration','Visceral Fat Reduction','5&#x2013;10% Weight Target','Sarcopenia Prevention','Behavioral Change','Cardiometabolic Risk']},
  {label:'Track 04 — Glycemic Health',title:'Prediabetes &amp; Type 2 Diabetes',desc:'Glycemia is a cardiovascular risk factor — and often reversible. This track targets A1c reduction, insulin resistance, and CV-protective pharmacotherapy alongside lifestyle-driven remission pathways.',tags:['A1c Reduction &#x2265;0.5&#x2013;1.5%','CGM-Guided Behavior','SGLT2 + GLP-1 Therapy','Remission Pathways','Nutrition Timing','Fiber &amp; Glycemic Load']},
  {label:'Track 05 — Vascular Risk',title:'Hypertension &amp; Dyslipidemia',desc:'Targeting BP &lt;130/80 and guideline-directed lipid goals through the synergy of lifestyle and pharmacotherapy — with structured pathways for medication de-escalation when clinically appropriate.',tags:['BP &lt;130/80 mmHg','LDL-C / ApoB Targets','Sodium &amp; DASH Diet','Home BP Monitoring','Nonstatin Therapies','Med De-escalation']}
];
function selectTrack(el,i){
  document.querySelectorAll('.track-card').forEach(c=>c.classList.remove('active'));
  el.classList.add('active');
  const d=trackData[i];
  document.getElementById('track-detail').innerHTML=`<div class="td-label">${d.label}</div><div class="td-title">${d.title}</div><div class="td-desc">${d.desc}</div><div class="td-tags">${d.tags.map(t=>`<span class="td-tag">${t}</span>`).join('')}</div>`;
}

const reveals=document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
const obs=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
  entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('visible');obs.unobserve(e.target);}});
},{threshold:0.08});
reveals.forEach(el=>{obs.observe(el);if(el.getBoundingClientRect().top<window.innerHeight)el.classList.add('visible');});
</script>

</body>
</html>
